end.summary: Explored “unity in diversity” through music, food, festivals, languages and dress.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining how different regional styles can combine and enrich society, using examples such as music, food, harvest festivals and clothing. They gave relevant examples and later connected learning new languages with teamwork and inclusion. At first, they described differences as sometimes causing problems, but later explained that sharing and learning new words can help everyone feel included (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask Riya to make a small chart showing one shared feature and one difference among three festivals.
